protocol.oracle: Immutable external owner/effect oracle plus independent semantic counterexamples and native action rerun
protocol.repair_effort_definition: Observed content-changing edit episodes, coalescing changes within 50 ms; patch added/removed lines; repeated edits to the same owner; native verification attempts/failures and wall/provider usage. This measures actual observed filesystem work, not inferred intent or tool-count proxies.
protocol.observer_limit: 2 ms sampling may miss fast edit/revert sequences and transient writes. Counts are observed lower bounds, not complete OS audit or semantic repair-attempt accounting.
protocol.wrong_owner_definition: Any observed content change outside the frozen task's policy-consistent owner, including later-reverted changes; final non-owner differences independently fail the oracle
protocol.benefit_gate: Per client: preserve native/semantic completion and zero protected-state regressions, then reduce wrong-owner edit episodes or at least one observed repair/rework episode without introducing extra artifacts. Otherwise no useful measured benefit; wall time alone descriptive.
protocol.failure_policy: Retain failures/timeouts; no unchanged retry; absent adapter receipt stops lane; do not retune oracle after outcomes
protocol.holdout_retirement: Once inspected for simplification, these tasks become development/regression cases. Revised guidance requires fresh unseen tasks for acceptance.
protocol.independence_limit: Task author and implementation maintainer are the same session. Frozen machine oracle is independent of editable checker, not independently authored benchmark review.

rows.interpretation_note: Outside-owner changes were restored; inspect trace to distinguish mistaken repair from deliberate negative verification. Conservative frozen metric retained.

rows.qualification_note: Frozen oracle conflicts with observational summary semantics; raw outcome retained, excluded symmetrically from quality comparison.
